quickPick.productName: 77 Inch Class LG OLED evo AI C5 4K Smart TV 2025
quickPick.useCases: you mainly watch in a darker room, prefer using a tabletop stand, or want excellent OLED picture quality at a lower price point

quickPick.productName: 77 Inch Class LG OLED evo AI G5 4K Smart TV 2025 with Supplied Wall Mount
quickPick.useCases: your room has lots of natural light, you want to wall-mount flush to the wall, or you play fast-paced competitive games on PC

products.summary: Features Brightness Booster technology for enhanced luminance in bright environments, reaching up to 800 nits peak brightness.
Boasts Brightness Booster Ultimate, significantly increasing peak brightness to 2,100 nits for exceptional performance in very bright rooms.
Offers a 120Hz native refresh rate with VRR support up to 144Hz, suitable for smooth gaming and sports.
Supports a 120Hz native refresh rate with VRR capabilities up to 165Hz, ideal for high-refresh-rate gaming and fast-paced content.
Utilizes α9 AI Processor 4K Gen8 for advanced picture optimization and upscaling.
Features α11 AI Processor 4K Gen2, offering enhanced AI-powered picture and sound improvements.
Includes VRR support up to 144Hz, G-Sync Compatible, and FreeSync for a smooth gaming experience.
Offers VRR support up to 165Hz, G-Sync Compatible, and FreeSync, with an enhanced α11 processor for superior gaming performance.

similarities: Both use self-lit OLED evo pixels that turn completely off for perfect blacks and infinite contrast.
Both include LG's webOS 25 smart TV platform with built-in apps for Netflix, Disney+, and major streaming services.
Both support Dolby Vision, HDR10, and HLG for premium content.
Both have α9 AI Sound Pro with virtual 11.1.2 up-mix for immersive audio.
Both are Wi-Fi 6E enabled for fast and reliable wireless connectivity.
